class.name: EnemyAct
class.brief_description: A resource class that defines the ACT state for enemies in battles. Contains available ACT options and whether the enemy can be spared in this state.
class.description:
[EnemyAct] is a resource class used to define different states of enemy behavior in UT-Godot-Engine's battle system. Each EnemyAct represents a specific state that an enemy can be in, determining what ACT options are available to the player and whether the enemy can be spared.
This class is used within the [Enemy] class's [member Enemy.enemy_acts] array to create dynamic enemy behavior that changes based on player actions or story progression.
[b]Default ACT Options[/b] The class comes with four default ACT options: • "* 살펴보기" (Check) - Shows enemy stats and information • "* 모욕하기" (Insult) - An insulting action • "* 장난치기" (Prank) - A playful action with a joke • "* 한숨쉬기" (Sigh) - A contemplative action
[b]Usage Example[/b] [codeblock] # Create a new enemy state var enemy_state = EnemyAct.new()
# Add custom ACT option var custom_act = ActInfo.new() custom_act.act = "* Talk" custom_act.description = PackedStringArray(["* You tried to talk to the enemy."]) enemy_state.acts.append(custom_act)
# Make enemy sparable in this state enemy_state.sparable = true [/codeblock]
[b]Integration with Enemy System[/b] EnemyAct resources are referenced by the [Enemy] class through its [member Enemy.enemy_acts] array and [member Enemy.current_act] index. When the enemy's state changes via [method Enemy.change_act], different ACT options become available to the player.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

members.member:
Array of [ActInfo] resources defining the available ACT options for this enemy state. Each [ActInfo] contains an action name and description text that will be displayed when the player selects that action.
Default acts include: • Check - Shows enemy information and stats • Insult - Displays insulting dialogue • Prank - Shows a playful joke interaction • Sigh - Shows contemplative dialogue
You can modify this array to add custom ACT options or remove existing ones to create unique enemy interactions.
Determines whether the enemy can be spared. When this value is set to true, the player can spare this enemy and the name turns yellow. Default value is false.
